title: Mike Mignola — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
The self that experiences Mike Mignola is a committee, not a king. Michael Mignola (; born September 16, 1960) is an American comic book writer and artist best known for creating Hellboy for Dark Horse Comics, part of a shared universe of titles including B.P.R.D., Abe Sapien, Lobster Johnson, and various spin-offs. He has also created other supernatural and paranormal themed titles for Dark Horse including Baltimore, Joe Golem, and The Amazing Screw-On Head.

The cold light on Mike Mignola leaves the facts intact and only the comfort removed. There's some Miltonian stuff to the geography of my Hell, the Hell I'm doing is much closer to the world I created in The Amazing Screw-On Head. Won "Best Writer/Artist" Eisner Award, for Hellboy: Almost Colossus, Hellboy Christmas Special and Hellboy Jr.
